title: Coordinate differential compatibility of external Alexander--Whitney maps
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ scheme morphisms, $U:I\to\operatorname{Opens}(X)$ and $V:J\to\operatorname{Opens}(Y)$ arbitrary families, and $F,G$ modules on $X,Y$. Suppose $l_{p,q}$ are $k$-linear maps from the tensor product of scalar Cech cochains in degrees $p,q$ to the product-family Cech cochains in degree $p+q$, with the front/back coordinates of [lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-bidegree]. Define $t_n$ by the tensor-total coproduct universal property, transporting $l_{p,q}$ along $p+q=n$. For every $n,p,q\in\mathbb N$ and $p+q=n$, let $i_{p,q}$ be the tensor-total summand inclusion. Then $i_{p,q}\circ t_n\circ d_{\mathrm{target}}=i_{p,q}\circ d_{\mathrm{total}}\circ t_{n+1}$, with compositions read left to right. No finiteness or covering hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Substitute n=p+q. Recover l_(p,q) through the total inclusion. Expand the total differential using Mathlib d_eq, inclusion formulas, d_1_eq and d_2_eq. The signs are 1 and (-1)^p; the coproduct desc equations recover the adjacent bidegree maps with the necessary degree casts.

Apply morphism and tensor-product extensionality. Transport the equality by the scalar-to-module additive Cech isomorphism. Naturality of degree casts and differential commutation transport the left and both right terms. Identify each of the three bidegree evaluations with the ordinary cup of projection-refined cochains.

The scalar identifications and unique projection-refinement maps commute with the differentials. Rewrite their commutation equations and apply the proved cechCupCochain_leibniz identity. Its degree casts and integer sign coincide with the tensor-total terms, completing the pure-tensor equality.

proof_origin.place: Existing ordinary Cech Leibniz identity after projection refinements of Tag 01FD; fully proved by R2

theorem picardExternalCechCupDegreeMaps_comm_ι
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    (l : ∀ p q : ℕ, ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj
          (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + q))
    (hl : ∀ p q, IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p q (l p q))
    (n p q : ℕ) (hpq : p + q = n) :
    HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F)
      ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G) (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p q n hpq ≫
      picardExternalCechCupDegreeMaps f g U V F G l n ≫
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).d n (n + 1) =
    HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F)
      ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G) (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p q n hpq ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F)
        ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G) (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).d n (n + 1) ≫
      picardExternalCechCupDegreeMaps f g U V F G l (n + 1)
